name: I-Magnetics
intro: Isifundo esilinganayo (2-D) somshini omde: ukuhlukana okuthe xaxa kwensimbi, amamagnethi ahlala njalo nezinsimbi zocingo emabhokisini omoya. Xazulula ukuze ufunde ukuminyana kwe-flux, imigqa ye-flux kanye namandla esinto, bonise umphumela engxenyeni bese uyalondoloza. Isisetshenziswa sokuhlaziya, akusiyo imvume yokuklama.
tpl.ccore.about: I-C ensimbi enegebe lomoya emlenjeni wayo wangaphambili kanye nokhoyili ozungeze umlenje wayo wangemuva. Ihlolwe ngesekethe yamagnethi: B egebeni = μ0·NI / (igebe + umzila wensimbi / μr), ngaphandle kokuphuma kwamandla.
tpl.frame.about: Imagnethi ehlala njalo emlenjeni owodwa wesakhiwo sensimbi esivaliwe. Ihlolwe ngesekethe yamagnethi: B kumagnethi = Br·(lm/μrm) / (lm/μrm + L/μr).
tpl.keeper.about: Ijoka elinesimo se-U linemagnethi esisekelweni sayo kanye nomgcini phezu kwezinsimbi ngegebe elincane; kucelwa amandla omgcini. Ayikho ifomula yesandla, futhi amandla egebe elincane alinganiselwe: qhuba Ejwayelekile kanye ne-Okuhle uqhathanise.
tpl.wire.about: Ukhondakta oyodwa ojikelezayo owethwele ukugeleza kwamandla. Ihlolwe nge-B = μ0·I / 2πr ngokabili womsakazo wayo.
tpl.wires.about: Okhondakta ababili abade abahambisanayo bagxilisa ngaphandle. Ihlolwe nge-F = μ0·I² / 2πd ngemitha; umphetho webhokisi lomoya usebenza njengodonga, ngakho lesi sibonelo sisebenzisa ibhokisi elinobubanzi obu-4 × usayizi wabo.
err.no_sketch: Le ngxenye ayinasikethi. Dweba iphrofayili evaliwe yezinto emasikethini (izinto ezithintanayo emasikethini ahlukene), noma sebenzisa isibonelo.
sketch.touching: Iphrofayili ngayinye evaliwe iyinto. Izinto ezithintanayo zigcinwa emasikethini ahlukene; zonke izikethi kufanele zibe endizeni eyodwa.
note.planes: Izikethi zisendizeni ezahlukene: ucwaningo luzithatha njengesigaba esisodwa esiyisicaba, nomphumela ubonakala endizeni yesikethi sokuqala.
note.face_plane: Isikethi sisendaweni yohlangothi noma endizeni yesisekelo: umphumela ubonakala endizeni yangaphambili, ngezixhumanisi zesikethi ngokwaso.
region.curve_note: Izibalo ezimbili ze-B (T) ne-H (A/m), ngayinye ngomugqa, zombili zikhuphuka. Ngejika insimbi iyagcwala; ngaphandle kwalo iba mugqa nge-μr enikeziwe. Izinombolo ziwelakho: akukho ishidi ledatha elifakiwe.
box.note: Umphetho walo ugcina insimu ingaphumi (A = 0 lapho), njengodonga: nikeza umoya owengeziwe uma insimu ifinyelela kuwo.
msg.nothing_to_show: Akukho okuzobonakala: thikha okungenani into eyodwa ngaphansi kwethi Engxenyeni.
msg.placed: {n} izinto zokubonisa zibekwe engxenyeni (isinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa).
msg.placed_skipped: {n} izinto zokubonisa zibekiwe; zishiywe ngaphandle ukuze zihlale ngaphansi komkhawulo wesibonisi: {what}. Sebenzisa imeshi Ejwayelekile ukuze ubonise konke.
res.plot_alt: Ukuminyana kwe-flux |B| kuwo wonke umgogodla (umbala ophezulu ungumphakathi wesi-99 nangaphezulu), nemigqa ye-flux kanye nemiphetho yezinto
res.flux: Imigqa ye-flux {n}; {dA} igeleza phakathi kwemigqa emibili eseduze ngokujula kwe-{d} mm.
res.force: Fx {fx} N, Fy {fy} N, ukuphenduka {tau} N·m
res.depth_note: Amandla ayesijulile esingu-{d} mm (umphumela wensimbi ongumsindo ngamitha × ukujula), kusuka kusisindo se-Maxwell ebhokisini elizungeze into emoyeni; ukuphenduka kusuka maphakathi nento.
res.check_off: Umphumela nefomula yesandla ayivumelani ngaphezu kwalokho esibonelo esikulindele: nikeza umoya owengeziwe ezinto, imeshi emihle kakhulu, noma hlola izibalo.
problem.saturation: |B| enkulu ingu-{B} T ensimbini enokuvumela kuphela: insimbi yangempela igcwala cishe ku-2 T, ngakho yinike ijika le-B–H.
problem.force_thin: Amandla kwento {n} afika ngegebe lomoya elincane futhi ayinganiselwe: qhuba Ejwayelekile kanye ne-Okuhle uqhathanise.
part.note: Umphumela ubekwa endizeni yesifundo njengezinto zokubonisa: izinto kusuka endizeni kuya ekujuleni, insimu eduze kwazo (ingxenye yesisindo semodeli ezungeze kuzo) ngasohlangothini lwazo olukude. Ukubonisa kuphela: akukho isisindo, akukho ku-STL noma STEP.
part.placed: {n} izinto zokubonisa engxenyeni. Zigcinwa kanye nengxenye; Hlehlisa uzisuse.
group.name: Isifundo semagnethi (|B| enkulu {B} T)
svg.legend: |B| kusuka ku-0 (ublue omnyama) kuya ku-{B} T nangaphezulu (okubomvu; okukhulu kunazo zonke ngu-{max} T); {dA} phakathi kwemigqa ye-flux eseduze.
limits: Imingcele: izigaba ezimbili (2-D) zezinto ezinde kuphela, akukho i-axisymmetric noma 3-D; izinsimu ezinzile, akukho ama-eddy current noma i-hysteresis; amamagnethi ku-recoil line eqondile (akukho i-demagnetization knee); insimbi iyisilinganiso uma ungakanikezi ijika le-B–H; amandla kusuka ku-Maxwell stress ancike emeshini eduze nento (qhathanisa Ejwayelekile ne-Okuhle). Zonke izinombolo zezinto zakho noma zesibonelo, hhayi ishidi ledatha. Isisetshenziswa sokuhlaziya, akusiyo imvume yokuklama.
